advisor_ref.digest_head:
# Hat wave synthesis — dispatch-ledger-retire

Seats returned: hat-facts-gaps, hat-alternatives, hat-user-impact. Dropped: none (risks and value seats not in the 3-seat wave).

Accepted and applied to plan.md:
- D2 retargeted to `bee dispatch wave --run` (wave_run.rs); the returned-nothing predicate is written; zero rows is not flagged.
- D1 keep-set row-status skip dropped: it would prune where the code keeps a missing or corrupt cell file. One reconcile call after the cap guard, warn-only.
- D

cells.title: Mark a worker row capped at cap
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT D1 as refined in plan.md Requirements D1. In cap_cell_from_flags (handlers_close.rs), after the cell guard drops, call crate::verbs::state_group::reconcile_capped_workers(main_root); on Err warn and continue, mirroring worktree/phases.rs:1164-1173. Do not change read_prune_keep_set. Write the red test first: a capped cell's worker row reads `capped` after cap. Edit only existing tests the change forces.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- reconcile_capped cap

must_haves.why: A finished cell's dispatch row stops reading running, so the ledger stops growing stale.
truths: after cap the cell's workers[] row has status capped
a failure inside reconcile leaves the cap green
a cell with no row changes nothing

cells.title: Test the cap row status and the keep-set fail-open
cells.action: Judge existing coverage first (reconcile_capped_workers tests at state_group/tests.rs:1110-1176), author only the gap: cap through the real verb marks the row capped; a prune keep set still contains a row whose cell file is missing; a capped cell's files are not kept. Cite the existing tests by name in the cap proof.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- reconcile_capped prune keep_set cap

must_haves.why: The ledger fix needs proof from a worker that did not write it.
truths: the named tests pass
the missing-cell keep case is pinned

cells.title: Flag an empty wave and name each entry's rebuild command
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT D2 and D3 as refined in plan.md. In wave_run.rs finish_value add `empty_wave: true` and a one-line `empty_wave_reason` when at least one row ran and every row has outcome null, exit null and empty output; zero rows is not flagged. In the dispatch wave entries (prepare.rs run_dispatch_wave) add a `rebuild` string `.bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare --runtime <rt> --kind cell --cell <id> --worker w-<id> --json` using auto_wave_worker_name. Keep the worktree refusal. Red test first.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- wave

must_haves.why: A leader can tell a wave where nobody answered from one that launched nothing, and can rebuild any entry's payload.
truths: all-empty wave carries empty_wave true
a wave with one answer is not flagged
a zero-row wave is not flagged
every entry carries its rebuild command

cells.title: Test the wave flag and rebuild command
cells.action: Judge existing wave tests (wave_run.rs:290) first and author the gap: empty, non-empty, zero-row, and rebuild text containing `--cell <id> --worker w-<id>`.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- wave

must_haves.why: An independent worker checks the wave output shape.
truths: the named tests pass

cells.title: Remove the budget-overrun signal
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT D5 as refined in plan.md. Remove budget-overrun from KNOWN_SIGNALS and INTERVENTION_SIGNALS, the ESTIMATE_FIELD reader, cell_estimate_minutes and the overrun-2x-estimate counter with its tests, every budget-overrun line in supervisor-prompt.md (:85, :168, :179, :201), the catalog.rs watch-word text and the drivers/tests.rs:10847 case, and the knowledge doc mention. Then run `bee dev regen` to refresh mirrors and the registry payload and commit its output. Read-side tolerance of old rows stays.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- supervisor signal catalog prompt && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

must_haves.why: A signal that can never fire stops misleading the supervisor and its prompt.
truths: supervisor record refuses budget-overrun
struggling-loop and same-region-resubmit still record
no budget-overrun text remains in skills/ or the prompt mirrors

cells.title: Test the closed signal sets
cells.action: Judge existing signal tests first, author the gap: budget-overrun refused with the closed-set message; the other signals record; an old budget-overrun row on disk is dropped silently on read.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- supervisor signal

must_haves.why: An independent worker checks the closed set shrank and nothing else moved.
truths: the named tests pass

cells.title: State the transport check in the swarming contract
cells.action: Implement CONTEXT D4 as refined in plan.md. In bee-swarming's Delegation contract state that a dispatch reads transport_ready and transport_reason and that the fallback model applies only when the payload says transport_ready false. In the `bee herding status` no-job text (herding.rs near :1486) say it reports the calling session's own pane, not worker availability, and name the transport's env variables for herdr and tmux. Run `bee dev regen` and commit its output.
cells.verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --no-fail-fast -- herding status && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

must_haves.why: A leader reads one sentence instead of guessing whether dispatch has a transport.
truths: the swarming doc names transport_ready and transport_reason
herding status text states its scope

cells.title: Check dlr-4 docs parity and pointers
cells.action: Run the parity and pointer checks for dlr-4 as a second worker: bee knowledge check and the release-manifest check; report mismatches only.
cells.verify: .bee/bin/bee knowledge check && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

must_haves.why: A docs change needs a second pair of eyes.
truths: both checks pass

cells.title: Consolidate knowledge and write delivery.md
cells.action: Run `bee knowledge consolidate --feature dispatch-ledger-retire`, update the worker-ledger, dispatch wave and supervisor concepts to match the code, cite history D-numbers (not raw decision ids), and write docs/history/dispatch-ledger-retire/delivery.md.
cells.verify: .bee/bin/bee knowledge check

must_haves.why: The state layer must match what shipped.
truths: knowledge check passes
delivery.md exists

cells.title: Check the consolidated knowledge and delivery record
cells.action: As a worker sharing no context with dlr-6, run bee knowledge check and confirm delivery.md exists and its claims match the capped cells' diffs; report mismatches only.
cells.verify: .bee/bin/bee knowledge check

must_haves.why: A writer cell needs an independent check.
truths: knowledge check passes
delivery.md exists

cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- herding::status && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pointer_integrity

the report under docs/history/dispatch-ledger-retire/reports/dlr-8.md quotes each check
must_haves.why: dlr-4 and dlr-5 have no test-role checker.
